notes.title: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis Full Version Available!
notes.notes:

Undead Horde 2: Necropolis is now leaving early access and the full version is available! This includes all planned and unplanned features, Windows and Mac version (Linux via Proton/Steamplay) and all the localizations!

notes.title: Skeletal Avenger Full Version Launched on Steam!
Update Notes for 1.3.3 (macOS only)
notes.notes:
- Fixed rendering issues on macOS Big Sur
- Fixed launch crash on older macOS versions

The older macOS build can be found in macos_old branch, in case the newer build doesn't work on older macOS versions. To change the branch for a game:

[olist]
 Right click the game, and select Properties....
 Select Betas.
 Select the branch from Select the beta you would like to opt into drop-down list.
 Close the window. The game should update to reflect the selected branch.
[/olist]
